_instructions: Renders the FAQ section and the FAQPage schema markup. Good FAQ content is a real SEO asset — these answer the questions merchants actually search for.

faqs.q: How much does EPAY POS cost?
faqs.a: Software plans run from $17.99/mo for a standalone terminal up to $74.99/mo for full retail. Processing is a flat 2.3% + 5¢, or 0% if you run the cash discount program. Qualifying merchants can get hardware placed at no upfront cost through the Free Placement Program.

faqs.q: What is cash discount and how does 0% processing work?
faqs.a: Cash discount posts one price and offers a discount for paying with cash. Customers who pay by card cover the processing cost, which brings your effective processing rate to zero. We handle the compliant signage and receipt language so it's set up correctly.

faqs.q: Am I locked into a long-term contract?
faqs.a: No. There's no long-term lock-in on the software plans, and the Free Placement Program is not an equipment lease.
Most installs happen within a week of approval. Our team builds your menu or catalog before install day, handles the setup on site, and trains your staff on the system.

faqs.q: Can EPAY POS work with DoorDash, Uber Eats, and Grubhub?
faqs.a: Yes. Delivery orders route directly into the POS alongside your dine-in and phone orders, so there's no separate tablet to manage.

faqs.q: Do you help me figure out if I'm overpaying my current processor?
faqs.a: Send us a recent statement and we'll go through it line by line. Most statements have fees buried in the back pages that owners have never been shown. There's no obligation attached to the review.

faqs.q: When do I get my money?
faqs.a: Batches settle to your bank account the next business day.

faqs.q: What kind of support do you offer?
faqs.a: 24/7 support. Sales is at 947-228-7226 ext. 3 and customer service is ext. 5. We're based in Troy, MI.

faqs.q: How do I know if I'm overpaying my credit card processor?
faqs.a: Work out your effective rate: the total you paid in fees divided by the total you processed that month. A headline rate hides per-item fees, monthly fees and back-page line items; the effective rate does not. EPAY POS will do this read for free from a recent statement.

faqs.q: What is the difference between flat rate and interchange-plus pricing?
faqs.a: Flat rate is one published rate on every card — 2.3% + 5¢ at EPAY POS — so the cost is predictable per sale. Interchange-plus passes through the card networks' own rate and adds a fixed markup, so the cost moves with your card mix. Which works out cheaper depends on your mix and volume, which is what a statement review tells you.

faqs.q: Can I use my existing POS hardware with EPAY?
faqs.a: Tell us what you are running and we will confirm before you switch. For merchants replacing a system, hardware is placed at no upfront cost if they qualify on volume, and the menu or catalog is built before install day.

faqs.q: How long does it take to switch POS systems?
faqs.a: The menu or catalog is built before the hardware arrives, so the system runs from the first shift. Install and staff training are included, and the switch is scheduled so there is no downtime.

faqs.q: What POS systems does EPAY POS replace?
faqs.a: Merchants commonly switch from Toast, Clover, Square and similar systems. Restaurants, bars and retail stores switching an existing POS may also qualify for the $3,000 switch bonus.

faqs.q: Does EPAY POS work for retail as well as restaurants?
faqs.a: Yes. The Retail plan covers convenience and gas, liquor stores, smoke shops, grocery, pharmacy, boutiques and pet supply, with high-SKU inventory, scale and scanner support and age verification. Restaurants run on EPAY Table.
No long-term contract lock-in — that is included with every plan, alongside 24/7 support, free installation and staff training, PCI compliance assistance and next-day funding.
